### ⚡ Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def ml_linreg_gd(x):
    """
    Linear Regression (Gradient Descent)
    """
    x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    return np.round(x_arr, 4).tolist()
```
